findings.title: Review fallback treats a present nonregular Git entry as absent
findings.description: revision_regular_file returns false both when the reference is absent at reviewed_head_sha and when it exists there as a symlink, directory or other nonregular entry. review_evidence_exists then accepts a regular replacement at review_record_commit if the suffix is own-task review-only. The Thread Review Contract permits this fallback only for a reference absent at the reviewed revision. Independently reproduced complete integration_record_errors returning [] for both a reviewed symlink and a reviewed tree replaced by a regular own-review blob. Both suffixes correctly pass the strict linear own-task proof, so that proof does not close this gap.
findings.required_change: Distinguish exact Git entry absence from presence with a forbidden type before admitting the recorded-review fallback. Reject any present nonregular reviewed entry, preserve ordinary reviewed regular blobs, and add real-Git replacement regressions for symlink/tree and any supported nonregular mode. Rerun affected checks and obtain fresh SHA-bound reviews.

summary: Independent GENERAL review requires changes for one provenance admission gap. Scope, revision-bound task evidence, historical replay and unchanged merge semantics otherwise passed the focused review. Green declared and independent test runs do not close the independently reproduced nonregular replacement defect.
verification: Read the protected-base-to-reviewed-head diff, authority index, review/governance/result/merge contracts, own governance record and preparation independently. The 30 changed paths exactly equal the governance declaration, with no task packet, application, DB, migration, CI, product, release or frozen authority changes.

Independently verified all eight final check payloads: tested_commit bd3811fb283d9cbcca9bbb1dbd8d52bb0035f3ae, protected base, commands/check IDs, PASS/zero exit, raw SHA-256 and byte counts. Verified all indexed authority hashes and manifest sizes/hashes against exact reviewed Git blobs.

Confirmed implementation, provenance tests, both harness contracts and derived index/manifest are byte-identical between tested and reviewed revisions. The tested-to-reviewed suffix contains only the governance record and new own evidence. Existing failed/interrupted first-round checks remain historical, not final PASS evidence.

Independently reran 57 focused real-Git provenance and existing integration/delayed-review/exact-tree regression cases: all passed, 119 unrelated tests deselected. Cases cover normalized paths, whole task components, absent/unbound/ambient files, changed-then-reverted code/result/task evidence, nonancestor or nonlinear suffixes, reviewed regular blob content binding, ordinary delayed references and unchanged exact-tree squash restrictions.

Independently reran protected-ancestry five-candidate replay: KL027 18, KL075 3 and KL076 1 original review-evidence errors become zero; KL077/KL079 remain zero. Every actual normal merge has two parents and contains the recorded review parent, and every strict suffix passes. Source copied preflight hash and complete replay raw bytes agree with committed evidence. No official integration record or product PASS was written.

Loaded validator source directly from the exact reviewed Git revision and reproduced symlink-to-regular and tree-to-regular own-review replacements. Both exact reviewed entries exist and are nonregular; both strict suffix proofs and full integration validation return no errors. This violates the new contract's absence prerequisite and is the review blocker.
limitations: This review is CHANGES_REQUIRED at the exact stated SHA. A corrected implementation revision, new required evidence and fresh independent reviews are required; no merge recommendation is made.
Only GENERAL review bookkeeping was written. No implementation, previous task artifact, integration record or other review type was changed or committed.
No DB lifecycle or hosted CI was run as part of GENERAL review. Applicable final hosted CI, specialist reviews, task/product requirements, release and merge remain separate facts.
